title: appsci-bench artifact-agent session-API contract (versioned)
description: Meta-schema validating each versioned contract document at schema/contracts/session_api.v<N>.json. Each file is the complete, self-contained contract for one version: the served session API (create/query/delete), payload type defs, framing, and conformance note. The evaluator loads the latest version by default and broadcasts it to the appsci agent as part of its build context; it can load an older version to negotiate compatibility. Add a version = add a file; nothing in the file is pinned by Python signatures.

version.description: Contract version. Each file pins one value; bump on any shape change so evaluator and artifact can negotiate compatibility.

doc.description: repo-relative path to the human-readable contract doc

$defs.description: Machine-readable JSON-Schema defs for the wire payloads (single source of truth for their shape).
